title: To Know You is to Love You
lyrics_plain:
(Intro)
To know you is to love you,
but to know me is not that way, it seems.
'Cause you made me so happy
that my love for you grows endlessly.
When I'm down and feelin' sad,
you always comfort me.
When I'm down and feelin' sad,
you always comfort me-e.
Baby, to know you is to love you,
your smile, when I see your face.
'Cause there is no one on this earth,
baby, could ever, ever take your place.
(Break)
When I'm down and feelin' sad,
you always comfort me.
When I'm down and feelin' sad,
you always comfort me.
Oh, woh, to know you is to love you,
is to see you bein' free as the wind.
'Cause the power of your lovin'
is too strong to hold within.
To know you is to love you,
to see you blowin' free in the breeze.
The power of your lovin',
I never found a woman like you
that could be my lover and my best friend.
